i_bearskin.lore.common: Tickles the nose of every guard standing next to it, and none of them are allowed to sneeze.

x_cardigan_sweater.lore.common: Gets its sleeve caught on every door handle, then unravels a little bit more each time.

x_cloak.lore.common: Drags its hem through every puddle, so it comes home heavier than it left.
x_cloak.lore.legendary: Has walked every mountain road in the north and kept its wearer warm through a hundred winters.

x_socks_pair.lore.epic: Vanished in the washing machine with every other sock in the house, and turned up a week later inside the duvet cover.
